verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a self-hosted Git service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or a switch to disable either. Self-hosting under the MIT license with 'full control' and the admin config panel are adjacent features, not a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
